entries.title: Ezekiel 22:1
segments: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:2
segments: And you, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? And you shall make her know all her abominations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:3
segments: And you shall say, So says the Lord Jehovah: The city sheds blood in her midst that her time may come, and makes idols against herself to defile [herself].

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:4
segments: You are guilty in your blood that you have shed; and you have defiled yourself in your idols you have made. And your days [are] brought near, and have come to your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all lands.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:5
segments: [Those who are] near and [those] far from you shall mock against you, O defiled of name, abounding in tumult.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:6
segments: Behold, the rulers of Israel, each man by his might, have been in you in order to shed blood.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:7
segments: In you they have despised father and mother. In your midst they have dealt with the stranger by oppression. In you they oppressed the orphan and the widow.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:8
segments: You have despised My holy things, and have profaned My sabbaths.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:9
segments: In you are men of slander to shed blood; and in you they eat on the mountains; in your midst they do unchaste acts.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:10
segments: In you they have uncovered their fathers' nakedness; in you they have humbled her defiled by impurity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:11
segments: And a man has done abomination with his neighbor's wife; and a man has defiled his daughter-in-law in unchaste acts; and a man has humbled within you his sister, his father's daughter.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:12
segments: In you they have taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken usury and increase, and you gained by extortion of your neighbors, and you have forgotten Me, says the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:13
segments: And behold, I have struck My palm against your unjust gain which you have made, and at your blood which has been in your midst.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:14
segments: Can your heart stand, or can your hands be strong, in the day that I shall deal with you? I the LORD have spoken, and [I] will act.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:15
segments: And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you in the lands, and will destroy your uncleanness out of you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:16
segments: And you will be profaned in you before the eyes of the nations, and you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:17
segments: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:18
segments: Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them [are] bronze, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the middle of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:19
segments: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: Because you have all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:20
segments: [As they] gather silver, and bronze, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it to melt [it], so I will gather [you] in My anger and in My fury, and I will leave [you there] and melt you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:21
segments: And I will gather you and blow on you in the fire of My wrath, and you shall be melted in the middle of it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:22
segments: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you shall be melted in the middle of it; and you shall know that I the LORD have poured out My fury on you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:23
segments: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:24
segments: Son of man, say to her: You [are] a land not being cleansed, nor rained on in the day of disgust.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:25
segments: A plot [by] her prophets [is] in her midst, like a roaring lion tearing the prey. They have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they multiplied her many widows in her midst.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:26
segments: Her priests have broken My law and have defiled My holy things. They have put no difference between the holy and the common, and have not taught between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from My sabbaths, and I am defiled among them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:27
segments: Her rulers in her midst [are] like wolves tearing the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, to get unjust gain.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:28
segments: And her prophets have daubed themselves [with] lime, seeing vanity and divining lies to them, saying, So says the Lord Jehovah; when the LORD has not spoken.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:29
segments: The people of the land have used oppression and practiced robbery, and they have troubled the poor and needy. Yea, [they] have oppressed the stranger without right.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:30
segments: And I sought for a man among them who should wall up a wall for the land, and stand in the break before me, that I should not destroy it. But I did not find one.

entries.title: Ezekiel 22:31
segments: Therefore I have poured out My fury on them. I have burned them up with the fire of My wrath. I have given their way on their heads, says the Lord Jehovah.
